# A Windows play session, as the process list shows it to the write gate (G3).
#
# The layout is Blizzard's as documented, not yet a capture from Julia's
# machine. Battle.net and its helpers live in Program Files (x86)\Battle.net,
# the update agent in ProgramData\Battle.net\Agent, and the voice proxy in
# the game's Utils folder:
#   https://www.file.net/process/battle.net%20helper.exe.html
#   https://file.info/windows/agent_exe.html
#   https://www.file.net/process/wowvoiceproxy.exe.html
#
# Format: "== <step>" starts a step; each line after it is one process,
# "name|path" (an empty path: access denied). {WOW} is the WoW folder.
# "expect: free" or "expect: held <exe>" is what the gate must say then.

== Battle.net open, WoW not started yet
Battle.net.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.exe
Battle.net.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.15634/Battle.net.exe
Battle.net Helper.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.15634/Battle.net Helper.exe
Battle.net Helper.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.15634/Battle.net Helper.exe
Agent.exe|C:/ProgramData/Battle.net/Agent/Agent.9361/Agent.exe
explorer.exe|C:/Windows/explorer.exe
expect: free

== WoW running, with its voice proxy
Battle.net.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.15634/Battle.net.exe
Battle.net Helper.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.15634/Battle.net Helper.exe
Agent.exe|C:/ProgramData/Battle.net/Agent/Agent.9361/Agent.exe
WowB.exe|{WOW}/_classic_beta_/WowB.exe
WowVoiceProxy.exe|{WOW}/_classic_beta_/Utils/WowVoiceProxy.exe
expect: held WowB.exe

== WoW running, its path unreadable (another user, or elevated)
Agent.exe|C:/ProgramData/Battle.net/Agent/Agent.9361/Agent.exe
WowB.exe|
expect: held WowB.exe

== WoW crashed: the crash reporter is up, the game is gone
Battle.net.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.15634/Battle.net.exe
BlizzardError.exe|{WOW}/_classic_beta_/BlizzardError.exe
WowVoiceProxy.exe|{WOW}/_classic_beta_/Utils/WowVoiceProxy.exe
expect: free

== WoW closed; the voice proxy and the reporter's folder linger
Battle.net Helper.exe|C:/Program Files (x86)/Battle.net/Battle.net.15634/Battle.net Helper.exe
WowVoiceProxy.exe|{WOW}/_classic_beta_/Utils/WowVoiceProxy.exe
Reporter.exe|{WOW}/_classic_beta_/Blizzard Error/Reporter.exe
Agent.exe|C:/ProgramData/Battle.net/Agent/Agent.9361/Agent.exe
expect: free

== Something else in the WoW folder (a renamed game fails closed)
Launcher.exe|{WOW}/Launcher.exe
expect: held Launcher.exe

== A WoW-named exe outside the folder (another install)
Wow.exe|D:/Games/World of Warcraft/_retail_/Wow.exe
expect: held Wow.exe

== Everything closed
explorer.exe|C:/Windows/explorer.exe
expect: free
